## Updraft 0.7.5

- **Clipboard search for Claude (off by default).** A new switch in Settings > Connectors, "Also let them search my clipboard history", lets Claude Desktop and Claude Code on this PC search and list what you copied: text, links and pictures, never files. It works on this PC only, never over web access. Secret-looking text (passwords, keys, card numbers, one-time codes) is hidden and can't be searched.
- **Capture my voice (off by default).** A new card in Settings > Dictation > Improvement keeps short clips of your voice only, for tuning Updraft to how you talk. Other voices are dropped before anything is saved. It pauses while you dictate, record a meeting or take the Voice Test, and stops at 20 GB. Clips stay on this computer, and "Delete all clips" removes them.
- **Fixed: Claude Desktop extension stuck on "starting".** With Claude Desktop set to its built-in Node, the Updraft extension now connects right away.
